$sources: NTC-Sismo (Normas Técnicas Complementarias para Diseño por Sismo): Sec 1.4 zoning, Sec 3 spectra (Tabla 3.1 of the zone parameters, the 2004 edition's form), Sec 4 reduction Q' and Sec 5 the factor Q, Sec 6 regularity, Sec 8 static method (8.1 forces, 8.5 eccentricity), Sec 9 dynamic analysis, Sec 1.8 drifts; the 2017 edition's site-specific spectra (SASID: k, β) and overstrength R
source: NTC-Sismo (see the sources of each entry; the 2004 zone spectra with the 2017 site-specific form available)

generatorSystems.$comment: SAEngine practice: the New Building generator's steel systems, least ductile first (Q = 2, 3, 4)

I.description: Zona I, lomas: firm ground (rock or very compact soil)

II.description: Zona II, transición: firm ground under shallow clay layers

IIIa.description: Zona IIIa, lacustre: soft clay (the lake zone, sub-zone a)

IIIb.description: Zona IIIb, lacustre: soft clay (sub-zone b)

IIIc.description: Zona IIIc, lacustre: soft clay (sub-zone c)

IIId.description: Zona IIId, lacustre: soft clay (sub-zone d)

rcSpecialWallFrame.name: Concreto: muros con marcos de gravedad (Q = 3)

rcOrdinaryWallFrame.name: Concreto: muros con marcos de gravedad (Q = 2)

rcDualSpecial.name: Concreto: sistema dual de marcos dúctiles y muros (Q = 3)
rcDualSpecial.note: Q = 4 where the frames take at least half the storey shear (Sec 5.1(b)): SAEngine takes 3, on the safe side.

allowableDriftLabel: Non-structural elements attached to the structure

driftLimits.label: Non-structural elements separated from the structure (or able to take the drift)

sources.designSpectrum: NTC-Sismo Sec 3 (2004 edition, Tabla 3.1): a = a0 + (c - a0) T / Ta below Ta, c to Tb, c (Tb / T)^r beyond, by zone (I: c 0.16, a0 0.04, Ta 0.2, Tb 1.35, r 1; II: 0.32, 0.08, 0.2, 1.35, 1.33; IIIa: 0.40, 0.10, 0.53, 1.8, 2; IIIb: 0.45, 0.11, 0.85, 3.0, 2; IIIc: 0.40, 0.10, 1.25, 4.2, 2; IIId: 0.30, 0.10, 0.85, 4.2, 2); Sec 4: a / Q' with Q' = Q for T >= Ta, 1 + (T / Ta)(Q - 1) below; Q' × the regularity factor (Sec 6.4: 0.9, 0.8 or 0.7 for an irregular, very irregular or strongly irregular structure; 1 here, set it under Code Values); the 2017 site-specific form (k, β, R = k1 R0 + k2) applies where a site class is given k (enter the SASID values under Code Values)
sources.siteClasses: NTC-Sismo Sec 1.4 and Fig 1.1: zones I, II and III (IIIa-IIId); S = a0 of the zone for the peak ground acceleration (pgaFactor 1, Z 1)
sources.systems: NTC-Sismo Sec 5: Q = 4 (5.1), 3 (5.2), 2 (5.3), 1.5 (5.4), 1 (5.5) by the system and its detailing (R holds Q); Cd = Q (the displacements of the reduced forces × Q, Sec 1.8); Ω0 = the 2017 R0 (2.0 for Q >= 3, 1.75 for Q = 2: SAEngine reading, VERIFY.md); no height limits (the static method is limited to 30 m, Sec 2.2: not checked)
sources.periodCoefficients: NTC-Sismo gives no approximate period formula (the static method may take T from the Rayleigh quotient, Sec 8.2): the ASCE 7-22 Table 12.8-2 values as SAEngine practice; a period from the analysis at most 1.4 Ta
sources.designCategories: SAEngine's category letters for the zones (I: B, II: C, III: D; Group A one up): NTC-Sismo has no design categories, the letters only drive SAEngine's generator and orthogonal effects
sources.allowableDrift: NTC-Sismo 2004 Sec 1.8: 0.006 with non-structural elements attached, 0.012 separated (the 2017 limits by system of Tabla 4.2.1 are not entered)
sources.driftAmplification: NTC-Sismo Sec 1.8: the drifts of the reduced forces × Q
sources.lateralForce: NTC-Sismo Sec 8.1: Fi = Wi hi (Σ W / Σ W h) a / Q' (the modified distribution of Sec 8.2 for T > Tb is not applied)
sources.designEccentricity: NTC-Sismo Sec 8.5: e = 1.5 es + 0.1 b and es - 0.1 b
sources.liveShare: NTC-Criterios Sec 6.1: the instantaneous live load Wa in the seismic weight, taken as 0.7 Wm (SAEngine practice; Tabla 6.1.1 gives Wa about 0.5-0.7 Wm by use)
sources.minimumScale: NTC-Sismo Sec 9.3: the dynamic base shear at least 0.8 a W / Q'
sources.orthogonalShare: NTC-Sismo Sec 8.7 / 9.4: 100 % in one direction + 30 % in the other
sources.stability: NTC-Sismo Sec 8.6: second-order effects where the drift exceeds 0.08 V / W (θ = P Δ / (V h) >= 0.08)
sources.irregularities: NTC-Sismo Sec 6 regularity conditions: not checked by this version (set the regularity factor)
sources.torsionAmplificationMax: NTC-Sismo has no amplification of the accidental torsion (it is in the 1.5 es): 1.0
